protocol.name: continuation-screen-official-general-v01
protocol.scope: Exploratory development screening; fixed seed does not guarantee bitwise reproducibility. Historical greedy outputs are not matched comparators.

gecturk.note: exact_match alone understates valid alternative corrections -- every wrong-and-not-format-failure item needs the manual four-way taxonomy pass (correct-but-different / over-correction / under-correction / meaning-changed)

tquad.note: low_em_high_f1 items usually indicate boundary/normalization mismatch (extra/missing words around a correct span), not a comprehension failure -- inspect these separately from genuine wrong answers

xquad_tr.note: low_em_high_f1 items usually indicate boundary/normalization mismatch (extra/missing words around a correct span), not a comprehension failure -- inspect these separately from genuine wrong answers

wmt_en_tr.note: this is the EN->TR direction (CETVEL's task is misleadingly named wmt-tr-en-prompt) -- a direct test of Turkish generation quality, not a TR comprehension check

mlsum_tr.note: ROUGE is a reference-overlap signal, not a faithfulness measure -- manually inspect the stratified sample below (high/low ROUGE, truncations, longest/shortest source) before concluding anything about summary quality

scores.note: Reference-overlap metrics; no pooled accuracy. Incomplete generations retained, not dropped.

text.policy: raw text; no BOS/EOS; first token/document not scored; 2047 new targets/window

grammar.policy: BOS + raw sentence, no EOS, summed log probabilities; ties are not wins

manifest.selection: Random(3407) sample equally per task, round-robin submission; selected before generation
manifest.timing_note: Per-request generation_seconds overlap under batching; use wall_seconds for aggregate throughput.
